newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Jan 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Jan 16.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has sought whole-hearted cooperation from her party's lawmakers in the government's relentless efforts to further improve law and order in the country.

Jatiya Party chairman, former president Hossain Mohammad Ershad, has asked the rank and file of his party to establish their dominance over the politics in Dhaka as it is the nerve centre of national life.
President Justice Shahabuddin Ahmed said the present government had been giving prority to the development of energy and mineral resources.
The criminal investiogation department (CID) of police has submitted chargesheet against alleged killers of Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman and his family members.

Traffic jam at Aricha, Nagarbari and Daulatdia ghats on Wednesday kept 3,000 trucks and buses stranded. The situation worsened when about 500 trucks reached Aricha ghat, facing shortage of ferry serives, in the afternoon loaded with fertilizer.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has expressed her government's resolve to build the country facing all odds and sought cooperation of all in this regard.
The Chittagong Export Processing Zone, the country's first EPZ with over 80 different types of industrial units, is still running short of water, according to investors'sources.
Power generation in the Raozan 210MW power station is likely to be resumed from today after five months following resumption of gas supply to the plant.
